items.title: Zelenskyy Says Starlink Speed Restrictions Look Deliberate
items.content: Restrictions on Ukraine’s military use of SpaceX’s Starlink system appear to be deliberate and not the result of any technical problems, President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said, while denouncing a US decision to waive sanctions against Russia.

items.title: AI Selloff Tests Investor Confidence
items.content: Ritholtz Wealth Management Chairman and Chief Investment Officer Barry Ritholtz tells Bloomberg This Weekend that AI remains a transformational technology, but investors face a difficult task determining which companies will ultimately emerge as winners and losers. Speaking with hosts David Gura and Christina Ruffini, Ritholtz discusses CoreWeave’s selloff, concerns about AI financing and valuations, and the challenges facing Tesla as competition in electric vehicles intensifies. (Source: Bloomberg)

summaries.en: The AI sector faces investor scrutiny as technology continues to transform industries, but identifying winners and losers remains challenging. Ritholtz Wealth Management's Barry Ritholtz highlights concerns over AI financing and valuations, citing CoreWeave's selloff as an example. Additionally, Tesla's electric vehicle competition intensifies, presenting further challenges. The discussion underscores the difficulty investors face in navigating the AI landscape amid market volatility. (98 words)

items.title: The EV Bust Creating a New Battery Boom
items.content: Factories built to supply America’s electric-vehicle boom are getting a second life making batteries for the power grid.  As EV demand weakens and electricity demand from data centers and new factories strengthens, battery makers are shifting toward stationary storage, but the new market still relies on federal incentives and a supply chain that remains partly dependent on China. The shift is visible at TransGrid’s Atlas projects in Arizona, where the contractor Qcells is using LG Energy Solution’s US-made battery cells. (Source: Bloomberg)

This shift is evident in projects like TransGrid’s Atlas in Arizona, where Qcells uses U.S.-made LG Energy Solution battery cells. (Source: Bloomberg)

items.title: David Byrne Explains How Forgotten Ideas Come Back to Life
items.content: History is littered with ideas that have been tossed aside, only for them to gain relevance at some later date. Think of Moby-Dick: forgotten in Melville's time, but now regarded as the great American novel. Or the work of economist Hyman Minsky, which became influential a decade after his death, when the 2008 financial crisis made “the Minsky Moment” a mainstream term. These are just a couple of the things we talk about with the legendary musician David Byrne on today's podcast. Byrne's new book, Sleeping Beauties: Why Good Ideas Go Dormant and How They Wake Up, looks to categorize numerous “sleeping beauties” — ideas that were lost but then rediscovered. Besides Melville and Minsky, we also talk about the lost Roman recipe for concrete and we get into Byrne's thoughts on how to write a song and his own experience of having his music rediscovered by a new generation. (Source: Bloomberg)

summaries.zh: 著名音乐人大卫·伯恩在最新著作《沉睡的公主：为何好点子会沉寂又重现》中，探讨了被遗忘的创意如何重获生机。书中以《白鲸》和经济学家海曼·明斯基的理论为例，说明这些创意在特定时期被忽视，后因时代背景重获关注。伯恩还提及失传的罗马水泥配方等案例，并分享了创作歌曲的见解以及自身音乐被新一代重新发现的经验。

The podcast explores why dormant ideas regain relevance and touches on Byrne's songwriting process and his music's rediscovery. The conversation highlights the cyclical nature of intellectual and creative resurgence.

items.title: Wall Street Week | America’s Relationship Woes, Battery Pivot, Farmers’ Fed Warning
items.content:
This week, global and business leaders gathered in New Delhi for the Bloomberg New Economy Forum to discuss how the world is redrawing supply chains and investment plans in the face of geopolitical risks. And, in her new book former Canadian deputy prime minister Chrystia Freeland and Former Treasury Secretary Yellen say that the US needs stronger economic ties with its allies. Plus, can storage technologies rescue battery factories built in the hopes of stronger EV adoption? Later, as inflation picks up in the US, the heartland feels the effects more severely.
 (Source: Bloomberg)

summaries.en: Apple has appointed a former Meta Platforms executive as its new litigation chief amid a growing number of lawsuits. The move is part of a legal team shake-up, aimed at strengthening Apple's defense against increasing legal challenges. The appointment reflects the company's efforts to enhance its legal capabilities as it navigates various litigations.

items.title: Anthropic Signs First Data-Center Deal in Canada With EverWind
items.content: Anthropic PBC signed its first data-center lease in Canada, agreeing to buy capacity at a new project that’s worth more than C$10 billion ($7.1 billion) in the eastern province of Nova Scotia.
items.contentSnippet: Anthropic PBC signed its first data-center lease in Canada, agreeing to buy capacity at a new project that’s worth more than C$10 billion ($7.1 billion) in the eastern province of Nova Scotia.

summaries.zh: Anthropic PBC与加拿大EverWind公司签订首份数据中心租赁协议，将在新斯科舍省东部投资超10亿加元（7.1亿美元）的新项目获取容量。这是该公司在加拿大的首个数据中心合作。
summaries.en: Anthropic PBC has secured its first data-center lease in Canada, signing an agreement to purchase capacity at a new project in Nova Scotia. The project, valued at over C$10 billion ($7.1 billion), marks a significant expansion for Anthropic in the region. This lease represents the company's initial step in establishing a presence in Canada's data-center market.

items.title: Thomas Hoenig on Rate Hikes, Inflation Outlook
items.content: Thomas Hoenig said Kevin Warsh’s refusal to signal the Fed’s next move was appropriate and gives policymakers flexibility ahead of the late-October meeting. Hoenig noted that inflation has risen and could climb further, citing energy costs and their spillover into core prices. He speaks with Romaine Bostick & Kristine Aquino on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

Hoenig noted that inflation has risen and could climb further, citing energy costs and their spillover into core prices. He speaks with Romaine Bostick & Kristine Aquino on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

summaries.zh: 托马斯·霍尼格认为，凯文·沃什拒绝暗示美联储下一步行动是恰当的，这为政策制定者提供了在10月下旬会议前的灵活性。他指出，通胀已上升，并可能进一步攀升，原因是能源成本上升及其对核心价格的影响。他接受罗马内·博斯蒂克和克丽丝廷·阿基诺在《收盘》节目中的采访。（信息来源：彭博社）
summaries.en: Thomas Hoenig, speaking on "The Close," supported Kevin Warsh's approach of not signaling the Fed's next move, which he deemed appropriate for policy flexibility ahead of the late-October meeting. Hoenig highlighted rising inflation, potentially driven by energy costs and spillover effects into core prices, suggesting it could continue to climb. (Source: Bloomberg)

items.title: Janus Henderson CEO on Going Private, M&A Deals
items.content: Janus Henderson CEO Ali Dibadj said the firm is energized by its move to private ownership and is using the flexibility to invest in people, technology including AI, new products and client service. He said quarterly earnings pressures had constrained those investments, despite the firm’s growth as a public company. He speaks with Romaine Bostick on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

He said quarterly earnings pressures had constrained those investments, despite the firm’s growth as a public company. He speaks with Romaine Bostick on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

summaries.en: Janus Henderson CEO Ali Dibadj stated that the firm is energized by its move to private ownership, using the flexibility to invest in people, technology (including AI), new products, and client service. He noted that quarterly earnings pressures previously constrained these investments, despite the firm's growth as a public company. The remarks were made during an interview with Romaine Bostick on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

items.title: Financing The AI Boom: Masters in Business with Bob Michele
items.content: Barry speaks with Bob Michele, CIO and Head of Global Fixed Income, Currency, and Commodities at JPMorgan. They discuss Bob's unconventional start at the University of Pennsylvania, the differences between the science of bonds and the art of equities, and whether the US is heading toward a recession. (Source: Bloomberg)

summaries.zh: 《融资人工智能热潮：商界大师鲍勃·米歇尔》一文介绍了摩根大通首席投资官兼全球固定收益、货币和商品主管鲍勃·米歇尔。文章探讨了他在宾夕法尼亚大学的非传统求学经历，分析了债券科学与股票艺术的区别，并讨论了美国是否面临经济衰退。内容源自彭博社报道。
summaries.en: In "Financing The AI Boom: Masters in Business with Bob Michele," Bob Michele, CIO and Head of Global Fixed Income at JPMorgan, discusses his unconventional career path at the University of Pennsylvania. He differentiates the science of bonds from the art of equities and addresses whether the US faces a recession. The conversation, sourced from Bloomberg, provides insights into finance and economic trends. (98 words)
